content.description: Hydraulic circuit diagram showing lock-up clutch engaged (ON state). Shows fluid flow from oil pump through solenoid No. 3 (ON), lock-up control valve, primary regulator valve, 1-2 shift valve to lock-up clutch and oil cooler. Yellow lines indicate pressurized fluid paths, red indicates high pressure areas.

Hydraulic circuit diagram showing lock-up clutch disengaged (OFF state). Shows fluid flow from oil pump through solenoid No. 3 (OFF), lock-up control valve, primary regulator valve, 1-2 shift valve to lock-up clutch and oil cooler. Yellow lines indicate pressurized fluid paths, red indicates high pressure areas. Flow paths differ from Lock-up ON state.
